ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based algorithm visualizer specifically tailored to step through arrays, sorting, and searching problems commonly found in competitive programming.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeForge – Coding Competition: Coding Round featuring 5 problems covering arrays, strings, searching, sorting, data structures, and algorithms.
ideas.title: CodePath Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact domain of the coding competition by helping students break down and learn how to mentally trace complex searching and sorting algorithms, fitting the algorithmic theme of the event.

ideas.pitch: A 1-on-1 real-time competitive programming arena where teams can solve timed data structure and sorting challenges together against the clock.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeForge – Coding Competition: Competitive programming event designed to test participants' problem-solving, logical thinking, data structures, and algorithmic skills within a fixed time limit.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the competitive programming format of the hackathon, providing immediate utility for students practicing for the coding round.

ideas.pitch: A specialized data structure analyzer that builds syntax trees and step-by-step evaluation traces for string matching and sorting constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeForge – Coding Competition: Problems will cover arrays, strings, searching, sorting, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving.
ideas.title: RegexTree Parser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific pain point of debugging tricky string manipulation and sorting edge cases during timed algorithmic rounds.

ideas.pitch: An automated static analysis tool that scans submitted code snippets to estimate time and space complexity based on loops, arrays, and sorting routines.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeForge – Coding Competition: Participants will solve programming problems within a fixed time limit and compete based on their performance.
ideas.title: ComplexityMeter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Helps competitive programmers instantly check if their algorithm's time complexity will pass strict platform test cases before submitting.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic test case generator that automatically produces edge cases for array, string, and sorting problems to stress-test participant logic.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeForge – Coding Competition: All submissions will be evaluated automatically through test cases. Participants must ensure that their submitted code passes the required test cases.
ideas.title: TestCaseGen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the evaluation constraint of the hackathon, ensuring participants can thoroughly test their algorithms against corner cases.
